name: memory-vault-dev
description: [DEV] Folder-local memory vault plugin for managing a user-provided knowledge repository folder, category indexes, and AGENTS.md rules.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Create and maintain folder-local knowledge repositories with category indexes and AGENTS.md rules.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides a passive skill for initializing and maintaining a user-provided folder as a memory vault, including 1-2 level category INDEX.md files and bounded AGENTS.md rules for how agents should read and update that vault.
defaultPrompt: Create a memory vault in this folder and add AGENTS.md rules for maintaining it.
Use the memory vault rules when I mention project knowledge, repository memory, persistent notes, or AGENTS.md memory rules.
Given this folder path, initialize or update the folder itself as a memory vault.
Add Programming/React as a memory vault category and update the root AGENTS.md category map.
